text.cs: Všichni recenzenti se shodují na velmi příjemném, vstřícném a lidském chování lékařského personálu. text.en: All reviewers consistently praise the veterinary team for their friendly, polite, and humane approach. Clients value genuine interest in animal health issues and professional guidance regarding treatment steps. title.cs: Kladný vztah ke psům a králíkům
title.en: Caring bond with dogs and rabbits

text.en: Guardians highlight the staff's gentle attitude toward pets, ensuring dogs often feel at ease visiting the practice without stress. text.en: Customers report high satisfaction with veterinary treatment outcomes.
